title: Chapter 4 Militia
content:
Chapter 4 Militia

I came to the lobby, walked to the lord's case, sat down on my knees, looked ahead, and saw that although there was no one under the stage, a sense of majesty naturally emerged in my heart, and this feeling of power filled people intoxicated.

There is a turtle and button copper seal on the case, and the painting hangs on it so vividly, as if it is alive in front of it, people are addicted to it at first glance, this is the symbol representing the greatest power of a territory.

When you touch it with your hands, the cold feeling of metal comes from your hands, and when you rub the copper seal, there is a slight blocking feeling, which makes people feel very secure, and there is no danger of falling from their hands.

"Ding, the base has been laid, the host has completed the territorial construction task, the initial construction of the territory has been completed, the host will be specially rewarded, and a primary gift package will be given to the host, please receive it as soon as possible."

The sound of the system's mechanization came from his ears, but Zhong Yu felt a sense of excitement in his heart. Is the novice spree finally coming? I knew that the system would not allow me to complete the task of building the territory as a person with no power.

"Open the primary gift package." Zhong Yu said in an excited voice, with a trembling voice, and his heart was full of tension.

"Ding, congratulations to the host, you have obtained a resource pack, a thousand stones of food, 100 taels of gold, a thousand taels of silver, and ten thousand taels of copper. The resources have been stored in the warehouse, and the host can check them at any time."

Hearing the system's voice, Zhong Yu didn't feel too happy, because what's the use of having so much food? If there is not much power to protect these resources, sooner or later, they will be taken away by others, and he will also have the worry of his own life.

Sitting in such a lord's mansion, it is definitely impossible to hide it. There will definitely be beasts, or savages will come here to investigate and discover their existence. What should I do then!

"Ding, since the host already has its own territory, it has initially caused some negligible impact on the world. You can get a fixed amount of air luck every month, and the system will give you a chance to draw a primary lottery. Whether the host will conduct a primary lottery ?" The mechanized voice of the system came again.

There is a chance to draw a lottery, which is great. If I can draw some soldiers and horses, then my territory will have some protection. The system is really understanding! But all of this is a lie, can you draw the army? It's up to your own luck!

"System, use the primary lottery chance to start the lottery!" Zhong Yu looked forward with expectant eyes, and saw a high-tech screen in front of him, with a turntable rolling on it.

"Ding, congratulations to the host, getting a team of fifty people from the Yellow Turban Army!"

Great, it seems that after all that life and death, whether it is extremely peaceful or not, the time will turn, and you will come to whatever you want. Just when you want the army, you get the army, and God is helping you!

Fifty yellow turban soldiers wearing yellow cloth strips and shabby but very thin clothes slowly appeared in the hall. Looking a little weak, but tightly grasping the weapon in his hand, bloodthirsty light flashed in his eyes, looking at everything, as if he was looking at food!

Zhong Yu has no doubts that as long as they are given enough food, they will be able to follow their own swords, invincible, and not retreat. Although the combat effectiveness may be a little worse, the spirit of not being afraid of death is very good. Food cravings can make them pay for everything! At least, they should be enough to deal with those beasts and savages.

"Who are you waiting for the leader, come and meet up quickly!" Zhong Yu said in a low voice with a sullen face, while at the same time estimating the strength of these Yellow Turbans.

When Zhong Yu's voice fell, in the lobby below, a taller man walked out, with a simple and honest face, looking like the kind of ordinary farmer who has worked in the farm all his life, even if this is the appearance of an ordinary farmer.

However, Zhong Yu didn't dare to underestimate him, because the aura emanating from him, the sharp eyes like an eagle, all showed that he was a very dangerous person, and he had definitely seen blood on his hands, and he was not One or two people, most likely dozens or even dozens of people.

"I have seen the lord!"

The simple and honest man, with his hands folded, leaned over and bowed to Zhong Yu, looking very respectful. Seeing the man's performance, Zhong Yu was very useful, and couldn't help but feel satisfied.

Sure enough, it was indeed as expected of me that I pulled it out from the system. I was really loyal to myself, and I understood what I meant. It was really useful. But the thought flashed in his mind for a while, and he immediately came back to his senses and said:

"What's your name?"

After hearing this, the simple and honest man immediately replied, "Back to the lord, because there was a cow in the family, the elders in the family called me Wang Daniu in order to ask the cow to grow up safely!" Good laugh for a while.

Wang Daniu also met the standard of naming a countryman, so he stopped caring about this issue and asked, "You are their leader, what is your official position?"

Hearing this question, Wang Daniu's face became serious, and he turned around and replied, "This subordinate is their team leader, leading fifty soldiers."

Well, fifty people is probably enough. They all seem to have experienced one or two wars. They are veterans, and their combat effectiveness should not disappoint themselves too much!

"Everyone is tired. After waiting for so long, there is some food in the warehouse. You can take it out and take care of your fill. In the future, everyone just needs to work hard for me, eat and drink, and wear and live. I am I won't treat those who have done me badly." Zhong Yu said to the soldiers with a smile, his face filled with a kind smile.

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, all the people were immediately refreshed and their expressions lifted. Ah, how long has it been since I was full, one year, two years, or three years!

I remember myself, since the natural disaster happened in my hometown, I have become a refugee, wandering constantly. Later, I heard that there is a general in Jizhou, who has great ability and is a reincarnation of an immortal. He can bring peace to the world and create a heaven on earth, so he run away.

Since I went with General Tiangong, although my life has gotten better, I can barely keep enough food and clothing, so I won't starve to death, but now I hear the current lord saying that I can manage my fill. Although I don't believe it, it's good to be able to eat. , it's better than the previous time in the Yellow Turban Army, where there was no last meal!

"Okay, let's go back and eat!"

Zhong Yu saw their suspicious eyes. Although he was a little unhappy, thinking about it, he still had to rely on them to work for his life, so he didn't care. After all, human beings are a little suspicious of the unknown before they have seen it with their own eyes.

"No, my subordinates retire."

Everyone bowed and bowed in unison, then exited the hall and ran to the warehouse. After about a quarter of an hour, there was a cheer full of joy from the warehouse, "Long live the lord, long live the lord. "

Hearing the cheers, Zhong Yu's face slowly improved, and he smiled again. He was worthy of himself and thought so for them.
